table.description: ServiceNow table, picked by the record number prefix: INC incident, CHG change_request, PRB problem, REQ sc_request (request), RITM sc_req_item (requested item), SCTASK sc_task (catalog task).

query.description: ServiceNow encoded query, for example active=true^priority=1^ORDERBYDESCsys_created_on. Conditions are joined with ^, OR conditions use ^OR. Reference fields can be dot-walked, for example request.number=REQ0010001 on sc_req_item or request_item.number=RITM0010001 on sc_task.

fields.description: Fields to return, for example number, short_description, state, priority, assigned_to. Omit for all fields.

display_value.description: true returns display values (labels such as "In Progress"), false returns raw stored values (such as state 2), all returns both as {display_value, value} pairs. Use false or all when you need raw values for an update.

cursor.description: nextCursor from a previous response (a non-negative numeric offset).
